title: Server-Side Template Injection Static Analysis Rules

rules.name: Template source built from dynamic input
rules.description: A template is compiled from a dynamic value instead of a static string or a template file name (jinja2.Template, flask.render_template_string, django.template.Template, mako.template.Template). Template syntax is executable, so a value derived from request data lets an attacker evaluate expressions and reach the underlying Python objects.
rules.remediation_example: return render_template('greeting.html', name=name)  # template is a fixed file, data is a variable
